title: Switzerland's Train: $240. China's: $28 | China Travel Expert
description:
Switzerland's Glacier Express costs about $240 in 2nd class. A scenic mountain train in China costs about $28 — nearly 9x less.

The Glacier Express (Zermatt–St. Moritz) is CHF 213 all-in for 2nd class: CHF 159 fare plus a mandatory CHF 54 seat reservation (glacierexpress.ch, 2026). For a comparable 2nd-class mountain ride, the Kunming–Lijiang high-speed train through Yunnan runs about ¥174–199 (~US$26–29) for roughly 3 hours of lake-and-mountain scenery. Different countries, same window-seat magic — a fraction of the price.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book Chinese rail on the official 12306 app (or Trip.com) about 15 days out; second class sells first on scenic routes like Kunming–Lijiang and Lijiang–Shangri-La.

瑞士冰川快车 $240，云南观景高铁 $28——同样的雪山车窗，差价近 9 倍。
